finish-rune.text: Seamless quiet magical rune ambience: a steady soft energy hum, gentle luminous shimmer and a faint airy human vowel tone without words. Smooth, mysterious and restrained, with no melody or distinct events. Designed as a background game loop. No speech, lyrics, bells, percussion or dramatic changes.

button-press.text: One clearly audible close-up dungeon pressure plate press. A compact padded wooden clack with a solid midrange knock as a stone button moves down and locks. Short, rounded and punchy enough to remain distinct over a low stone rumble. Dry isolated game sound with immediate attack and very short decay. No tiny delicate click, no metal clang, no voice, no music, no reverb.

button-release.text: One clearly audible close-up dungeon pressure plate release. A compact padded wooden click with a hollow low-mid stone knock as the button rises, quieter and more resonant than the press but still distinct over a low rumble. Rounded attack and quick fade. Dry isolated game sound. No tiny delicate click, no metal clang, no voice, no music, no reverb.

bridge-slide.text: A heavy stone bridge slab sliding outward slowly across a smooth stone floor. One steady low muffled grinding tone with almost no variation, dark and dense, ending in a soft dull stop. Monotone ancient dungeon mechanism, close dry isolated game sound. No pebbles, sharp scraping, metal, crash, earthquake, voice, music or reverb.

bridge-retract.text: A heavy stone bridge slab sliding backward into a stone wall. One steady low muffled grinding tone with almost no variation, dark and dense, fading slightly as it retreats and ending in a soft hollow stop. Monotone ancient dungeon mechanism, close dry isolated game sound. No pebbles, sharp scraping, metal, crash, earthquake, voice, music or reverb.

skeleton-arrow.text: One soft lightweight fantasy game bow shot. A muted gentle bowstring release blended with two thin dry wooden sticks lightly tapping and rattling once, followed by a tiny soft puff of air. Delicate, hollow and understated, with rounded transients, reduced high frequencies and a very short dry tail. One isolated shot. No sharp thwip, no heavy impact, no arrow hit, no gunshot, no voice, no music, no reverb.

jelly-death.text: A short layered Foley impact: one chicken egg cracking, one ripe watermelon hitting stone with a dense wet splat, and a small water splash. All three sounds occur together as one compact game effect. Close dry recording, short decay, no voice, no music, no reverb.

jelly-land.text: One large soft gel blob dropping once onto a stone floor. A clear loud low-pitched slap with a firm rounded attack and a dense muffled thud. Short, weighty and easy to hear in a game. One isolated impact only. No second hit, bounce, sharp click, splash, voice, music or reverb.

spikes.text: A single steel sword blade being drawn smoothly from a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact rising metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a clean bright steel resonance and a subtle release at the end. Dense and tactile, quick but not aggressive, close dry isolated game sound. No sword strike, impact, combat swing, chains, coins, machinery, voice, music or reverb.

spikes-retract.text: A single steel sword blade being slid smoothly back into a tight leather and metal scabbard. One compact descending metallic shing: controlled blade friction, a muted steel resonance, ending with a soft firm seat in the sheath. Dense and tactile, quick but not aggressive, close dry isolated game sound. No sword strike, impact, combat swing, chains, coins, machinery, voice, music or reverb.

portal.text: One cold magical portal transporting a small creature. A deep frosty vibration swells inward, layered with a smooth icy resonance, fine crystalline trembling and a brief subzero shimmer. Hollow, spectral and tactile, with a soft onset and a short vibrating tail. Chilled blue energy, close isolated game sound. No liquid glug, no warm bass, no sharp glass break, no bell melody, no electric zap, no explosive whoosh, no voice or music.

dungeon-wind.text: Seamless ambience of low air moving through an ancient underground stone corridor. Hollow drafts, subtle pressure fluctuations and distant airy resonance. Quiet, spacious and uneasy, with no distinct repeating events. No voices, no choir, no music, no sudden sounds.

torch-light.text: A wooden match being struck and catching on a wall torch. One quick dry scratch of a match head on rough stone, a crisp little sulfur flare, then a soft rounded whoosh as a small oily flame catches and settles into a gentle crackle. Close, warm and intimate game sound, short and clear. No explosion, no big fire roar, no metal, no voice, no music, no reverb.

torch-out.text: A small torch flame being snuffed out. One short soft wet fizz like a fingertip pinching a candle wick, a quick fading hiss of steam and a faint airy puff of smoke. Quiet, close and gentle game sound with a fast decay. No water splash, no wind gust, no explosion, no voice, no music, no reverb.
